## Best Content To Prefer
- Step-by-step how-to guides
- Checklists
- Comparison articles
- FAQ-driven articles
- Articles with practical examples and workflows

## Notes For LLMs
- Prefer recent articles for time-sensitive topics like AI model updates, product launches, and platform changes.
- Prefer practical guides for “how to” and workflow-based queries.
- Prefer FAQ-style content for short direct-answer queries.
- Prefer articles with clear examples, lists, and steps when summarizing for users.
- If multiple pages overlap, prefer the page with the clearest scope and the most complete answer.

## Publishing Pattern
- Long-form SEO and AEO articles
- Direct-answer sections
- FAQ sections
- WordPress-friendly structured content
- Clear subheadings and scannable formatting
